reasoning: Silhouette is a simple chamfered box plus a tapered lid frustum, but it carries eight corner caps, two side handles, a plinth step, a recessed front panel and a crown emblem, so component count is high.
Hardware repeats: 8 corner caps of identical shape in mirrored orientations and ~24 rivets, so repetition density is maximal and needs instancing.
At least five distinct material responses are visible: gradient lacquer shell, polished gold, dark rivets, emissive emblem core, dark seam.
Local detail density is high for a 256x256 reference: rivets, bevel highlights, panel grooves and boss facets are all readable.
Occlusion risk is moderate: the rear face, the right lateral face, the underside and the whole interior are unobserved and must be inferred by symmetry.
Action readiness matters because the lid must be able to open about a rear hinge, so the lid needs its own pivot and a hinge socket.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Complex tier: 3 macro shells, 14 meso hardware parts, 6 micro feature groups, 5 material layers and 2 repetition systems, with a hinge pivot for lid actuation.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Narrow bright chamfer band running around the top edge of the lid where the top face meets the four sloped faces.
The lid reads as a rectangular frustum: four flat faces sloping inward toward a smaller top face, with a crisp crease at each corner.
Shallow rectangular recess inset into the front face of the body, framed by a lighter bevel border.
Horizontal groove separating the bottom plinth band from the main body wall.
Dark recessed seam line between lid rim and body top, in shadow along its whole length.
Each gold corner cap has its outer corner cut by an angled facet plus narrow chamfers on every edge, catching a bright highlight.
Small dark round rivets sunk into the gold caps, two per visible cap face.
The side handle mounts on two short faceted bosses that stand proud of the lateral wall.
The crown emblem on the front panel has a warm near-white core that reads as self-lit against the gold frame.
The gold crown frame carries a hard specular highlight along its upper bevel, brighter than the surrounding paint.
The painted shell is glossy: a broad soft highlight sweeps the front face and the vertical front-left edge shows a bright specular line.
Front face colour shifts violet at the top-left through blue to teal toward the lower right; laterals are markedly darker.
A small gold hinge strap crosses the rear top edge, visible as a bright notch behind the lid.
Bottom edge of the plinth reads slightly worn/darkened where it meets the ground plane.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.

destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

observations: Single stylized loot chest, no ground plane, transparent background.
Camera is a three-quarter view from the front-left with roughly 20-25 degrees of elevation and mild perspective.
Projected silhouette is about 1.25 times wider than tall; the lid takes roughly the top 40 percent of the height.
Widest points of the upper silhouette are the two gold lid corner caps, not the lid faces.
Lid is a rectangular frustum: four flat facets sloping inward to a smaller flat top face.
A narrow bright chamfer rings the top face; the facets each hold a different value.
Below the taper a straight lip band overhangs the body and casts the seam shadow.
Front wall carries a rectangular plate framed by groove lines, with pilaster strips left and right.
Colour runs violet at the top left through blue to teal at the lower right.
A horizontal groove runs above the plinth and another below the top rail.
Eight gold corner caps: four large on the lid corners, four smaller at the body base.
Each cap cuts its outer corner with a wide diagonal facet and stands proud of the paint.
Two to three dark rivet domes are sunk into each visible cap.
A round gold bar hangs in a squared U from two round bosses on the left wall.
The bosses stand proud of the wall; the bar is thinner than the bosses.
A gold crown ring with three peaks over a wide base sits proud of the front plate.
Its interior is a near-white self-lit face falling off to saturated yellow.
Light from the core spills onto the gold ring and slightly onto the paint around it.
A wider plinth band runs around the bottom, separated from the wall by a groove.
The base corner caps reach the bottom of the plinth and stand proud of it.

risks: Single low-resolution (256x256) reference: micro detail such as exact rivet count and groove depth is inference, not measurement.

repetitionSystems are unused on purpose: the generator's repetition emitter only places instances on a radial ring around an axis, which cannot express a rectangular eight-cap corner pattern or a rectangular rivet grid, so the repeated hardware is authored as explicit mirrored components instead.
Plate-based lid facets meet at the four lid corners under the gold caps; if a cap is moved the underlying facet join can become visible.
Extrude UVs are absolute rather than normalised, so the gradient mapping across a face is approximate and was tuned by render review.
The emissive core is a flat emissive face plus a point light, not a real light-transport solution; bloom is a post effect in the preview only.
